data.title: 胡桃 · 翠竹幽径捉迷藏
data.description: 【胡桃 · 翠竹幽径捉迷藏】轻策庄青翠葱郁的竹林小径上，斑驳的晨光洒在青石板上。胡桃身穿休闲毛衣与百褶短裙，倚在一根粗壮翠竹后探出半边身子，将食指轻抵唇边做出噤声的手势，狡黠的大眼睛里满是想要吓人一跳的俏皮笑意——「嘘——！不要出声！本堂主这次一定要好好吓七七一跳！」
data.action: 倚在粗壮翠竹后探出半边身子，食指轻抵唇边做噤声手势，眼神充满恶作剧笑意
data.lighting: 竹叶缝隙漏下的斑驳明亮阳光
data.promptProse: Hu Tao leans around a thick bamboo stalk beside the stone path through Qingce’s grove. Only half of her figure has emerged: one index finger touches her lips while her other hand rests against the bamboo. A sly smile and bright flower-shaped pupils invite the viewer to keep her hiding place secret. Her loose dark sweater, red pleated skirt and knee-high socks fit the ordinary morning outing. Clear morning rays fall in broken stripes across the path and sleeves, with green leaves framing the eye-level view. No additional person or lettering.
